description: Submit a proposed action to Intended. Returns the compiled intent, Open Intent classification, and the decision (ALLOW / ESCALATE / DENY). On ALLOW, includes the signed single-use authority token to attach to the action. Fail-closed.

action.description: The proposed action, in natural language or a structured description.

actorId.description: Identity of the acting agent (for attribution/scoping).

args.description: Structured arguments of the action, evaluated by policy.

name: submit_intent
title: Submit an intent for an authority decision
